versions.content: On a call to Csm_RestoreContextJob() or Csm_SaveContextJob() the CSM shall check if the job references to either of the CsmPrimitive CsmHash, CsmEncrypt, CsmEncryptAEAD, CsmDecryptAEAD, CsmDecrypt, CsmMacGenerate, CsmMacVerify, CsmSignatureGenerate or CsmSignatureVerify. If so, the operation shall continue as specified. Otherwise, the operation shall not be performed and CSM_E_SERVICE_TYPE shall be reported to the DET when CsmDevErrorDetect is true.
